summary: 共享费用分摊与预算/ETC 实现首片 on BASE 4c0d309. Adds costing migration 0005_shared_cost_allocation and 0006_project_budget (generated after the actual leaf 0004, no applied migration edits) for SharedCostAllocationBatch/Line/Receipt and ProjectBudgetVersion/Line/Receipt, with vendor-aware SQLite/PostgreSQL append-only guards, conditional unique active allocation/budget, one-to-one reversal, and draft->posted/reversed and draft->approved/rejected, approved->superseded transitions only. Services add create_shared_cost_allocation_batch / reverse_shared_cost_allocation_batch: pool is strictly posted current nonproject costing cost postings in the period, reversed originals and negative reversal lines are pair-excluded, PH-250 project costs/revenue/cash/drafts/cross-org/cross-period are excluded, missing/non-positive pool refuses, fixed_weights and server-derived revenue/minutes/direct-cost drivers quantize to integer basis points summing 10000 (largest remainder), amounts use exact integer basis_points_clamped_half_up_last_absorb_v1 with last-item absorption and non-negative lines, duplicate active pool and source in multiple pools refuse; each allocation/reversal writes one net-zero AccountingEvent (source nonproject negative, project positive for allocation; exact mirror for reversal) with a SourceConsumption claim, never mutates original source postings, and appends plugin audit plus receipt. Budget services add create_project_budget/approve_project_budget/reject_project_budget/supersede_project_budget: draft versions, four-eyes approval (creator/submitter cannot approve), effective_from in period, one approved version per project/period (old approved superseded in the same transaction), append-only lines/subjects, contract-line snapshots validated for project/termination, expected_version/request_token/dry_run/company lock/period lock, append-only receipts; budget_residual_v1 read model derives budget/incurred/ETC/EAC/variance/over/remaining with missing semantics (null+missing, never zero), frozen issue codes budget_missing/over_budget/budget_lines_exceed_total/subject_attribution_missing. Adds read-only reconciliation and budget/ETC pages (costing routes history_read, period/pool/project filters, empty/missing/issues, role gating, disabled-module history read) and two verifier branches; the verifier now folds its two terminal COUNT queries into already-loaded Organization/LedgerEntry lists to keep the PH-244 query-count budget at 88. No canonical topic/command, no contract schema change, no core migration, no ledger outside costing, no revenue/cash/settlement writes. Actual runs: check 268; manage.py check exit0; makemigrations clean; fresh SQLite migrate+verify ok; scoped 10 tests OK; full 1204 tests/128.753s with only the known 8 macOS baseline failures; verify-change after report (review pending).
